objective: Identify the value of the best feasible alternative forgone, first through a stated personal preference and then an explicit fictional budget.
extensions: Personal next-best alternative without cash spending
Ordinal fictional preferences without utility scores
prerequisite_mastery: unknown; prerequisites are background assumptions, not inferred from age or IQ

tool_decisions.threejs: Required colorful 3D toy experience; raycast previews, fixed toy-to-label alignment, raised choice/alternative rings and bounded framing
tool_decisions.html_css: One question and primary action at a time, explicit confirmation, keyboard labels, original-budget context, comparison and reveal
tool_decisions.gsap: Batched presentation transitions and celebration; deterministic immediate rendering during seeks
tool_decisions.blender: Not needed: custom toy models built from local Three.js geometry

sources_reviewed: Exact local taxonomy topic and evidence
source_limitations: Local Munger research attributes emphasis using an unauthenticated transcript mirror. No Munger quote is reproduced. Official Fed/OpenStax definition pages were attempted but blocked by the configured proxy and were not read or cited as reviewed.
human_followup: Ask what the learner would do if their first choice were unavailable
Ask what they value about that alternative
Explain why Leah’s £10 movie counts despite £2 left after the robot
Invent a new decision and check that alternatives were actually possible
presentation: Progressive Three.js story: three personal adventures, explicit confirmation, next-best comparison, then fictional original-budget challenges. Astra consulted for design and implementation review.

personal_preference_scope.claim: Preferences are elicited, never objectively graded.

scene_sequence: Preview and confirm a personal two-hour adventure
Imagine it unavailable; choose the next-best adventure
Reveal the missed benefit and name opportunity cost
Identify Leah’s alternative with her original £10
Keep the robot choice fixed and change the original budget to £9
review_note: Design and code reviewed with Astra; browser and model verification do not establish child comprehension.
